Description.DefaultText: Hidden village-timeline phase gate: 0 = undiscovered (Inn Keeper intro only, Professor redirects, no trade/study, construction projects hidden), 1 = introduced (everything opens). Values 2+ reserved for future capstone phases. Set by the final line of the Inn Keeper's intro conversation; backfilled to 1 on old saves with real village progress (Well Plans or any quest-renown flag) or when the Village Inn trait is equipped.
